assessment: R loops have been described at the immunoglobulin heavy chain (Igh) locus long ago. However, their contribution to Igh diversification by class switch recombination (CSR) and locus integrity has been elusive. The authors show that R loop removal by the activity of senataxin and RNase H2 does not influence CSR but is required to suppress genome instability at the Igh locus. This article will be of interest to the audience in the fields of genome integrity and B lymphocyte biology.
